scope: Real model tool call + MCP stdio protocol. The live runtime->Gateway->Main correlation leg is NOT yet demonstrated.

mcpProtocol.transport: real stdio against the built CLI (vb mcp)
mcpProtocol.cancel: tools/call + notifications/cancelled sent on the same connection
mcpProtocol.conclusion: failure is never degraded to isError=false; the advertised list is filtered by the active driver

fix.problem: vb mcp exited immediately: the CLI deliberate post-command flush termination ran right after startMcpServer connected the stdio transport, so initialize/tools-list/tools-call never happened. The whole MCP surface was dead.
fix.change: packages/versebrowser/src/cli.ts keeps the MCP process alive after startMcpServer (await a never-resolving promise), applied through the sanctioned integration patch because src/cli.ts is a hash-pinned import.
fix.verified: module/host-integration/api-coverage verify pass (the manifest pins the patched hash); the MCP probe passes after the patch and timed out before it.

gap.detail: The model->Gateway->Main->driver correlation leg (requestId/toolCallId/session/owner/event) still needs a runtime-side run: the renderer gateway.rpc surface is intentionally read-only for mutations, so a probe cannot drive agentBrowser.invoke from the renderer.
gap.nextStep: find where the tool-call arguments are dropped (runtime provider adapter vs the local endpoint) so the call carries a real action/url and reaches Main; then the same spec can assert the requestId/session/owner/event correlation.
gap.notBlockedOnOwner: the local endpoint is live (127.0.0.1:3065); no owner action is needed for the next step.

liveAttempt.result: the live chain now runs: app -> main-layout, provider seeded, Gateway running, prompt sent, and the REAL model issued an agent_browser tool call through the runtime. It stops one step short of Main because the local provider returns empty tool arguments, so the runtime rejects the call with a schema validation error.
liveAttempt.providerLimitation: glm-5.3-flash returns arguments: {} for the tool call regardless of the prompt; hy3 does not call the tool at all
